prompt: An episode of the first season of the show Digimon had an English air date exactly 2 years before 9/11 - what Digimon destroyed the Black Gear in that episode?
answer: The Digimon was **Kabuterimon**. In the episode “Kabuterimon’s Electro Shocker,” Tentomon digivolves into Kabuterimon and destroys the Black Gear controlling Andromon.
